title: HECM Holding Limit: One Open Loan per Borrower
content:
**Clause.** A borrower may hold only one Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) at a time, because FHA insures one HECM per borrower and per principal residence. A new HECM is boarded only when the borrower holds no other HECM loan whose status is rescission period, active, due and payable or deferral period. The limit is 1 open HECM per borrower.

**Mutual exclusion with the Summit line.** A HECM and a Cedarline Summit first-lien reverse mortgage are mutually exclusive on the same borrower: a HECM must be the only lien-holder's reverse mortgage on the home, so a borrower with an open Summit loan of any plan other than Summit Second Lien cannot also hold a HECM, and a Summit Second Lien is never placed behind a HECM.

**What does not count.** Paid-in-full, rescinded and claim-terminated HECM loans do not count toward the limit.

**Evidence.** The test reads the company's loan records for the borrower — each HECM loan held under that borrower's customer reference and its status — before the new loan is boarded; it is not settled on the borrower's own account of what they hold.

| Other HECM loan already held by the borrower, status | New HECM may be boarded |
|---|---|
| rescission period | no |
| active | no |
| due and payable | no |
| deferral period | no |
| paid in full, rescinded or claim terminated | not barred by this limit |
| none | not barred by this limit |
